Captures every filter in the Filters panel — event types, the date field & range, every location-group, location, part, user and custom-field picker, and the beginning/ending tag boxes — plus the current view mode. Saving under a name you already use replaces that view. Views are stored against your Fishbowl user account, so they follow you to any machine.

Publishes your 0 view(s). Every user picks them up the next time they open this report. A view they already have under the same name is left untouched, and nothing else in their list is removed — this only ever adds.
Withdraws the published set so users who haven't opened the report yet stop receiving it. Copies already sitting in someone's list stay theirs.
Clears every other user's saved views the next time they open this report, then re-seeds whatever is currently shared (nothing, if you aren't sharing). Your own views are not touched. Cannot be undone.
